orientation.top_of_map: north; the landing chamber is at the east (right), the passage runs west, then turns north at the corner into the long hall
orientation.note_en: camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks; xy_m = xy x map_extent_m (origin top-left). Passage 1.4 m wide, 2.1 m clear height; everything outside the passage and chamber is solid earth and brick.

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the heap of sticks and dry leaves down the whole long low passage to the warm lamp-glow at the far corner, the White Rabbit hurrying away small in the distance
eye-level wide shot from the brick-vaulted middle of the passage back toward the dark landing chamber and the leaf heap, earth walls and hanging roots beyond the last brick rib
low medium shot from the root-laced earth stretch back at the leaf heap as the girl lands on it in a puff of dust, pitch black above
eye-level medium shot past the pastel-and-gold mosaic dado to the right-angle corner glowing with warm lamplight
eye-level medium shot round the corner into the short final leg of the passage, the long hall's lamplight and stone floor opening ahead
low close shot from the hall threshold back at the corner as the girl rounds it at a run, silhouetted against the dark passage
eye-level close shot from the leaf heap to the curtain of pale hawthorn roots hanging down the chamber's earth wall
high oblique wide shot from above the hall threshold angled down the corner and along the brick vault toward the mosaic dado, the passage vanishing into dark
high oblique detail shot from above the heap across its brittle summer-dry sticks and curled brown leaves toward the root-laced tunnel mouth, a drift of leaf dust

calibration.method: landmark xy re-measured on the delivered layout_top.png (door/opening landmarks read at the gap in the wall line)
